dialogues.jp: 「ふぁ〜……よく寝すぎた」

朝の心地よい光に背伸びしながら、新聞受けに
手をさしこむ。
dialogues.en:
I stretched my body in the morning sun, and reached my hand
into the mailbox.
dialogues.text:
I stretched my body in the morning sun, and reached my hand
into the mailbox.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう私がとりました」
きゅっ、とリボンを整えて音夢が笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled as she fixed her ribbon on her uniform.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled as she fixed her ribbon on her uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺の仕事をとるなよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そういうなら、春休みも早起きしてください
　よ。私だってテレビ欄見たいんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Then you have to wake up early during the break too. I
wanted to read the paper."
dialogues.text:
"Then you have to wake up early during the break too. I
wanted to read the paper."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お前、テレビ欄と４コマ漫画しか読んでない
　タイプだな！？」
dialogues.en: "You only read the television section and the comics."
dialogues.text: "You only read the television section and the comics."

dialogues.jp: びし、と音夢の額を指差す。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ちゃんと芸能も見てますぅ。それと、おでこ
　にばっかり指さしたり頭突きしたりしないで
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you point at me like that, I read the gossip section
too."
dialogues.text:
"Don't you point at me like that, I read the gossip section
too."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……いや、それは、全然まったくちゃんとじゃ
　ないだろう」
しかも素で返されてかなり寂しいぞ俺は。
dialogues.en: That's pretty bad that she's proud of it.
dialogues.text: That's pretty bad that she's proud of it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん。でも、兄さんが朝に起きてるなんて
　珍しいね。せっかく起こさないように静かに
　してたのに」
dialogues.en:
"It's so weird that you're up so early today. I was trying
to be quiet so I didn't wake you up."
dialogues.text:
"It's so weird that you're up so early today. I was trying
to be quiet so I didn't wake you up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、昨日は寝たのが早くてな。はっきり言っ
　て年寄りレベルの起床だった」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I went to sleep early last night. I woke up so early
I thought I was an old man."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I went to sleep early last night. I woke up so early
I thought I was an old man."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、よく眠れたんなら良かったじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's a good thing you slept well."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's a good thing you slept well."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それよりパジャマのまま外に出てこないでく
　ださい。近所の人に見られたら恥ずかしいじゃ
　ないですか」
dialogues.en:
"Anyways, don't come out in your pajamas like that. It's
embarrassing."
dialogues.text:
"Anyways, don't come out in your pajamas like that. It's
embarrassing."

dialogues.jp:
悪戯なのだろうが、久しぶりに音夢が裏モード
の声をあげる。
dialogues.en: I think she's just kidding around.
dialogues.text: I think she's just kidding around.

dialogues.jp: 「パジャマってなぁ」
ざっと全身を確認してため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I signed looking at my outfit.
dialogues.text: I signed looking at my outfit.

dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ、お前があのシャツ姿で外に出てたら
　犯罪だろうけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it would be a crime if you went outside in your shirt
pajamas."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it would be a crime if you went outside in your shirt
pajamas."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「わわわ！　出ない出ない、あんな恥ずかしい
　姿で外になんて絶対出ない！」
dialogues.en: "Wow! No, no. I won't go outside in that."
dialogues.text: "Wow! No, no. I won't go outside in that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「恥ずかしいという自覚はあったのか……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前じゃないの！　ぷんぷん！」
腰に手をあてて音夢が頬をふくらませる。
dialogues.en: Nemu placed her hands on her hip and puffed out her cheeks.
dialogues.text: Nemu placed her hands on her hip and puffed out her cheeks.

dialogues.jp: 「自分でぷんぷん言ってたら切りないぞ」

そもそもこいつ、その恥ずかしい姿で俺の前に
いることに気づいてないらしいな。
dialogues.en:
Maybe she doesn't realize that she's hanging out in front of
me with that embarrassing pajama of hers.
dialogues.text:
Maybe she doesn't realize that she's hanging out in front of
me with that embarrassing pajama of hers.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、調子は回復してるらしいな」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　うん。兄さんのおかげかな？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そ。兄さんが一生懸命、私のことを心配して
　くれたから治ったんだよ。きっと」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I think I got better because you worried about me. I'm
sure."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I think I got better because you worried about me. I'm
sure."

dialogues.jp: さわっ、とスカートを翻して音夢が微笑む。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そこで真面目に反応しないでよ！」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいから行けよ。会議に遅刻するぞ」
dialogues.en: "Go! You'll be late for the meeting."
dialogues.text: "Go! You'll be late for the meeting."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん、そうだね」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちゃんと真っ直ぐ帰ってこいよ」

と、家に戻ろうとして、なにかが服にひっかかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
And I entered the house, but something got caught in my
clothes.
dialogues.text:
And I entered the house, but something got caught in my
clothes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……ごめん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前はな……」

いつものように、振り返ると音夢が服のすそを
つまんでいる。
dialogues.en: I turned around and found Nemu hanging onto my clothes.
dialogues.text: I turned around and found Nemu hanging onto my clothes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「わざとじゃないよ！　悪気があるわけでもな
　いからね！」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「この場合は、反射のほうが嫌だと思うんだが。
　なんか忘れ物か？」
dialogues.en:
"What? It seems like a reflex, but did you forget
something?"
dialogues.text:
"What? It seems like a reflex, but did you forget
something?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え……いや、その……なんでもないんだけど」
音夢が服から離した手を振る。
dialogues.en: Nemu waved her hand as she let go of me.
dialogues.text: Nemu waved her hand as she let go of me.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ行けよ。俺は優雅な朝飯を……」
dialogues.en:
"Well then, go. I'm going to have a wonderful
breakfast......"
dialogues.text:
"Well then, go. I'm going to have a wonderful
breakfast......"

dialogues.jp: グィ――。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……あの、ごめん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これは、俺にパジャマのまま学園まで付き合
　えという無言の訴えか？」
dialogues.en:
"Does this mean you want me to walk you to school in my
pajamas?"
dialogues.text:
"Does this mean you want me to walk you to school in my
pajamas?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうじゃなくて……その……日課」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「日課？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……うんうん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「日課って、あれだよな」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ、あれだよ」
前髪を持ち上げて音夢が照れている。
dialogues.en: She lifted her bangs and looked shy.
dialogues.text: She lifted her bangs and looked shy.

dialogues.jp:
「止めたんじゃないのか？　それに、見るから
　に調子がいいんだが……」
dialogues.en: "I thought we stopped that. And you look fine to me......"
dialogues.text: "I thought we stopped that. And you look fine to me......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいからいいから」

ツン、と俺の胸に手をあて、背伸びをしてじっ
と目を見つめる。
dialogues.en: She touched my chest and stood up on her toes looking at me.
dialogues.text: She touched my chest and stood up on her toes looking at me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……日課にしようよ」
dialogues.en: "Let's start doing it every day again."
dialogues.text: "Let's start doing it every day again."

dialogues.jp:
小さな｛ささや／囁｝きを耳にしながら、そっと音夢の肩を
抱いて身体をひきよせる。
dialogues.en:
I held her shoulders and pulled her toward me as she
whispered in my ear.
dialogues.text:
I held her shoulders and pulled her toward me as she
whispered in my ear.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……えへへへ。充電完了」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、行ってきます」

胸を押さえて口元をゆるゆるにしながら、音夢
が小首をかしげた。
dialogues.en: Nemu tilted her head as she pressed her chest and smiled.
dialogues.text: Nemu tilted her head as she pressed her chest and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今日も１日、元気だよ」

本当に、久しぶりに元気な姿を見ながら、俺は
しばらくぼーっと立ち尽くしてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I haven't seen her that healthy for a while, and I stood
there spaced out.
dialogues.text:
I haven't seen her that healthy for a while, and I stood
there spaced out.

dialogues.jp: 春だな。おい。
◆新しい日課◆

郵便受けを覗くと、既に新聞は音夢によって回
収されていた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu had already picked up the newspaper as I went to get
it.
dialogues.text:
Nemu had already picked up the newspaper as I went to get
it.

dialogues.jp:
学園に向かう音夢に頼まれ、中断していた朝の
日課を再開する。
dialogues.en:
Nemu asked me to start doing the daily ritual again as she
was going off to school.
dialogues.text:
Nemu asked me to start doing the daily ritual again as she
was going off to school.

dialogues.jp:
本当に、久しぶりに元気な音夢の姿を見ながら、
俺はしばらくぼーっと立ち尽くしてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I stood there spaced out looking at Nemu so healthy, I
haven't seen her like that for a while.
dialogues.text:
I stood there spaced out looking at Nemu so healthy, I
haven't seen her like that for a while.
